scripts.test: node tests/play.mjs && node tests/dialogs.mjs && node tests/library.mjs
scripts.deploy: node scripts/stamp.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply grandpa-games --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.devices: wrangler d1 execute grandpa-games --remote --command "SELECT code, player, approved, name, datetime(last_seen/1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS last_seen FROM devices ORDER BY last_seen DESC"
